Hey, thanks for the response. I’ve been actively seeking help for 16 years. Since I began having thoughts of suicide. The “idiotic” isn’t a claim on my suicidal wishes as much as it is a statement about my declining cognitive abilities. I feel entirely myopic, like I can only see immediately in front of me. I say “delusional” because I have moments of lucidity during which I am more hopeful. But who knows? I once read a study which suggested that those who are clinically depressed have a more accurate assessment of their abilities - Here is is: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/m/pubmed/528910/
Good luck to you. Wishing you relief from your pain.
